query:
SELECT 
  'Admin' as type,
  u.id,
  u.name,
  m.tenantId
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN memberships m ON u.id = m.userId
WHERE u.role IN ('admin_bp', 'analyst_bp')

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Solicitação' as type,
  cpr.id,
  cpr.segment,
  cpr.tenantId
FROM commercialPointRequests cpr;
